'''Vordell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. He was known for being ruthless and not having a conscience. He was overweight and wore oversized [[shirt]]s to hide his girth, and had a thick goatee of brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that matched the wavy, but graying, hair on his head.

Vordell was the pilot of the ''[[Lost Opportunity]]'', a [[720 light freighter/Legends|Ghtroc 720]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].

==Biography==
Vordell discovered the floating wreckage of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]] ''[[Starworm]]'' and sold its location to many people, including [[Sude Raalo]] and [[Geelo]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

He was caught by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] officers from the [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Imperial customs corvette]] [[Auditor (corvette)|''Auditor'']]. He sold out his allies to prevent himself from getting sent to the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
